verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a hosted browser-infrastructure platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes sessions running on Browserbase's own cloud, and community threads present BrowserStation as an open-source alternative for people who want a self-hosted option, not as a Browserbase feature. No evidence shows Browserbase offers a self-hostable deployment of its core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
